column1: # Study 1 corpus sample: 20 of the 78 repos with both static baselines ok (phase1-results/static).
# Rule: triage admit=yes on Python 3.12, >=50 tests collected, ONE package (the tracer and the harness
# trace one package dir), redistribution=pass, no heavy native stack (torch/jax/GDAL repos left out),
# test suite not dependent on a live service (bitmapist, python-mysql-replication left out: >90% of
# tests fail without redis/MySQL). Then stratified HIGH 8 / MED 7 / LOW 5.
# PyCG deterministic preferred. 7 are not, and the bundle's PyCG edges are the UNION of seeds 0/1/42
# (static/pycg_baseline.py). pycg_seed_spread_pct = (max-min seed edge count) / union edges:
#   mild <=1%: marshmallow-sqlalchemy, ShivyC, rlm, pr-agent   moderate 3-5%: wsgidav, confluence-markdown-exporter
#   severe 24%: sqllineage (kept on purpose as the one stress case; report results with and without it)
# LOW is thin: kolla-ansible is the only deterministic LOW repo that passes the rule above.
# lock_sha256 is triage's pip freeze for this repo; batch.py refuses a lock.txt that does not match it.
# --- Extension, added 2026-10-19 BEFORE tracing any of these rows: every remaining static-ok repo
# admitted on 3.12 with >=20 tests collected (relaxed from 50), one package, redistribution pass.
# Heavy native stacks are no longer excluded (the amd64 VM installs torch/jax wheels). Left out:
#   bitmapist (tests need a live redis); mininet (needs root and kernel network namespaces). pycg_seed_spread_pct here = (max-min raw seed edges)/union raw edges.
